# Evidence Integration Ledger

## R01: Exact External Custody and Reopenability
Disposition: Confirmed externally custodied exact sources with reopenability preserved. Observed evidence [S02] establishes that candidate files, actions, effects, checks, and history are held outside the model boundary, enabling recovery without semantic loss. No unresolved conflicts observed; qualification is that receipts identify recoverable results but do not contain their semantic substance.

## R11: Interaction-First Roadmap with Fresh Transfer and Stopping Rules
Disposition: Recommended as next-phase policy pending validation. Observed evidence [S02] supports an interaction-first approach where fresh transfer occurs under defined stopping rules to prevent unbounded scope creep. Qualification: this is a proposal for external adjudication, not proof of completion; no current check validates the roadmap’s efficacy beyond structural alignment with bounded-context constraints.
